source_en: Sorry, here's the form. Luka Tsereteli. I'm ten.
School stopped two weeks ago. My teacher [[whisper:never came back]].
They locked the gates. I waited outside a while. Nobody came.
Block C, fourth floor, with my mum.
My dad's in Varka for work. Mum keeps calling. The phones don't connect.
They keep shaking. Mum says it's the cold. It's not cold.
No. My brain won't go quiet. I'm working on it.
Coming here helps. It's always the same.
